# Weekly digest email

A gentle Monday-morning nudge: what you kept up last week, what slipped, and
your longest live streak. The digest is a pure render over the same event log,
so it never disagrees with the board.

> Note: one of this ticket's declared dependencies (`CAD-207-nonexistent`) is
> intentionally not present in the manifest, so downstream dependency
> resolution surfaces it as an unresolved edge.

## Content

- Habits kept every expected day last week (celebrate).
- Habits missed at least once (encourage).
- Current longest live streak across all habits.

### Sections

| Section     | Source                          | Tone        |
|-------------|---------------------------------|-------------|
| Wins        | Fully-kept habits last week     | celebratory |
| Slips       | Habits with >= 1 miss           | encouraging |
| Spotlight   | Longest current streak          | motivating  |

```python
def build_digest(member, events, week):
    kept, slipped = partition_by_completion(events, week)
    return Digest(wins=kept, slips=slipped, spotlight=longest_live(events))
```

## Delivery

1. Runs once per week per member timezone (Monday 07:00 local).
2. Skips members with no habits.
3. Respects a per-member digest opt-out flag.[^optout]

[^optout]: Opt-out is honored at send time; a member who opts out mid-week
receives no digest that Monday.
